faq.q: How do I install Hill Climb Racing 2 on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for Hill Climb Racing 2 and check the developer is Fingersoft before tapping Install. It needs Android 7.0 or newer. It's free to install, and Play keeps it updated automatically. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from Fingersoft and may be altered, so the safest way to play Hill Climb Racing 2 is the official listing.
Cups, team events and leaderboards are online and need a connection. Adventure mode can be played offline, but progress syncs when you reconnect.
Yes, in an asynchronous way: in cups you race against recordings of other players' runs, and teams compete together in events.

faq.q: What's new in the anniversary update?
faq.a: The 10-year anniversary update adds The Climb, a roguelike deck-building challenge, The Great Below with floating underground tracks, and The Deep Caverns Cup.
